title: Week 1 review
topic: Security + Management & Governance — full Week 1 recap
format: 25 timed scenario questions (aim for ~40 min, ~96 sec each)

questions.question: An IAM administrator has AdministratorAccess but cannot create an EC2 instance. The organization uses AWS Organizations. What is the most likely cause?

options.A: The IAM user lacks an MFA device
options.B: A Service Control Policy (SCP) denies ec2:RunInstances
options.D: The VPC has no internet gateway

questions.question: Account A needs to share a private subnet with Account B for a Transit Gateway attachment. Which service enables cross-account subnet sharing?
A company wants single sign-on for employees to access 15 AWS accounts and Salesforce. Which service is purpose-built for this?
An ECS Fargate task fails with CannotPullContainerError. The task role has AmazonS3FullAccess. What should you fix first?

options.A: Add ECR permissions to the task role
options.B: Add ECR and CloudWatch Logs permissions to the task execution role
options.D: Attach a WAF Web ACL to the task ENI

questions.question: Traffic is allowed inbound on port 443 in a security group but blocked by the subnet NACL. After the connection is established, return traffic fails. Why?

options.A: Security groups are stateless; NACLs are stateful
options.B: NACLs are stateless and must allow ephemeral return ports explicitly

questions.question: Account B must decrypt objects encrypted with Account A's KMS CMK. Which combination is required?

options.A: IAM policy on Account B user only
options.B: KMS key policy on the CMK granting Account B + IAM policy on Account B principal

questions.question: You enable SSE-KMS on a high-traffic S3 bucket and costs spike from KMS API calls. Which feature reduces KMS request charges?
A developer asks where to store database passwords with automatic rotation and Lambda integration. What do you recommend?
Which statement correctly distinguishes KMS and Secrets Manager?

options.A: KMS stores application secrets; Secrets Manager stores encryption keys
options.B: KMS manages encryption keys; Secrets Manager stores and rotates secret values
options.C: Both services are interchangeable for password storage

questions.question: You need a free TLS certificate for CloudFront distribution d123.cloudfront.net. In which Region must you request the ACM certificate?

options.A: Same Region as the origin S3 bucket

questions.question: You attach a WAF Web ACL to an Application Load Balancer in eu-west-1. What WAF scope must the Web ACL use?
SQL injection probes hit your CloudFront distribution. Shield Standard is already active. What additional service blocks L7 application attacks?

options.B: AWS WAF with managed rule groups

questions.question: A security architect needs stateful inspection of east-west traffic between subnets in the same VPC. Which service fits?

options.B: AWS Network Firewall in the VPC

questions.question: An organization with 50 accounts wants to deploy a baseline WAF rule set to all CloudFront distributions automatically. Which service?
Which service answers: 'Which IAM user called DeleteBucket yesterday at 3 PM?'
An auditor needs cryptographic proof that CloudTrail logs were not modified after S3 delivery. Which feature?
You need continuous monitoring of whether any S3 bucket currently allows public read. Best approach?
An EC2 instance is mining cryptocurrency and communicating with a known malicious IP. Which service generates this finding?
An S3 bucket policy grants s3:GetObject to Principal '*'. Which tool identifies external access paths?
Developers need shell access to private EC2 instances without opening SSH port 22 to the internet. Recommended approach?
You must discover and classify PII in S3 buckets automatically. Which service?
A static website uses a public S3 bucket behind CloudFront. Config shows NON_COMPLIANT on S3_BUCKET_PUBLIC_READ_PROHIBITED but the site works. Best interpretation?

options.A: Config is broken — public buckets cannot work with CloudFront
options.B: The bucket policy allows public read, violating the rule; migrate to private bucket + OAC for compliance
options.C: GuardDuty will automatically make the bucket private

questions.question: A wiki API Lambda needs Cognito client credentials. Where should secrets live with least privilege?

options.A: Hard-coded in Lambda environment variables as plain text
options.B: Secrets Manager with IAM policy scoped to secretsmanager:GetSecretValue and kms:Decrypt

questions.question: A multi-account landing zone with guardrails and automated account vending is required. Which service provides this?
After completing Week 1 security labs, which resource should you tear down first to stop ongoing Config charges while keeping CloudTrail?

options.B: Run study-lab/week1-teardown-config.sh (Config recorder, rules, delivery bucket)
